ADDED i6: Skipping exactly zero bytes on a mark-supported stream returns 0 and does not change state.

ADDED i12: reset() on a stream constructed with markSupported=false throws UnsupportedOperationException.
ADDED i15: read(byte[]) reads up to buffer.length bytes and advances position by the number of bytes read.
ADDED i16: read(byte[]) on INSTANCE (empty stream, size=0) immediately hits EOF and returns -1.
ADDED i17: read(byte[]) with a zero-length buffer returns 0 immediately without reading or advancing position.
ADDED i18: mark() on a stream constructed with markSupported=false throws UnsupportedOperationException.
ADDED i21: After a read advances position to equal size (negative), the stream is at EOF. With throwEofException=true, skip() on an EOF stream throws EOFException.
ADDED i23: available() returns remaining bytes (size - position) when the result fits in an int.
ADDED i24: available() is capped at Integer.MAX_VALUE when remaining bytes exceed int range.
ADDED i25: available() returns 0 when size is negative (size - position <= 0).
ADDED i26: getSize() returns the exact size value provided at construction.
ADDED i27: getPosition() returns 0 on a freshly constructed default stream (no reads performed).
ADDED i28: Default NullInputStream() constructor enables mark support.
ADDED i29: init() resets position to 0, clears mark, and reopens the stream while preserving the configured size.
ADDED i30: With a negative size (-30), position(0) != size(-30), so read() does not hit EOF immediately. It increments position to 1 and returns processByte() which is 0.
